dates.title: Dates
dates.description: Launch days as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty + no other input = yesterday.

dateFrom.title: Date from
dateFrom.description: Start of a date range (max 62 days).

period.title: Leaderboard period
period.description: Daily, weekly (ISO week of the date) or monthly leaderboard.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Topic slugs or URLs, e.g. artificial-intelligence. Returns the top products of the topic (one product row each).

products.title: Products
products.description: Product slugs or URLs (producthunt.com/products/<slug>) for one detail row each.

includeProductDetails.title: Add product details to each launch
includeProductDetails.description: Website, rating, followers, categories, socials, YC flag. One extra page per product.
